title: A Simple Algorithm for Clustering Discrete Distributions
summary: We propose a simple, projection-based algorithm for clustering mixtures of discrete (Bernoulli) distributions. Unlike previous approaches that rely on coordinate-specific ``combinatorial projections,'' our algorithm is rotationally invariant and works by projecting samples onto approximate centers obtained via a $k$-means computation on the best rank-$k$ approximation of the data matrix. This resolves a conjecture of McSherry on the existence of such geometric algorithms for discrete distributions. The same algorithm also applies to continuous distributions such as high-dimensional Gaussians, providing a unified approach across distribution types. We prove that the algorithm succeeds under a natural separation condition on the cluster centers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于投影的简单聚类算法，可统一处理离散分布（伯努利）和连续分布（高斯）的混合模型，通过在数据矩阵的最佳秩-k近似上进行k-means计算获得近似中心，再进行投影分类，解决了McSherry关于离散分布几何算法的猜想。
AI.motivation: 现有离散分布聚类方法依赖坐标特定的"组合投影"，缺乏旋转不变性；McSherry猜想存在此类几何算法但未被证明。
AI.method: 投影算法：在数据矩阵最佳秩-k近似上执行k-means获得近似聚类中心，再将样本投影到这些中心进行分类。该方法具有旋转不变性。
AI.result: 算法在聚类中心满足自然分离条件时可成功恢复真实聚类，同时适用于离散（伯努利）和连续（高斯）分布。
AI.conclusion: 提供了跨分布类型的统一聚类方法，验证了McSherry猜想，证明了投影方法在分布聚类中的有效性。

title: Peer Identity Bias in Multi-Agent LLM Evaluation: An Empirical Study Using the TRUST Democratic Discourse Analysis Pipeline
summary: The TRUST democratic discourse analysis pipeline exposes its large language model (LLM) components to peer model identity through multiple structural channels -- a design feature whose bias implications have not previously been empirically tested. We provide the first systematic measurement of identity-dependent scoring bias across all active identity exposure channels in TRUST, crossing four model families with two anonymization scopes across 30 political statements. The central finding is that single-channel anonymization produces near-zero bias effects, because individual channels act in opposite directions and cancel each other out -- a result that would lead an evaluator to conclude that identity bias is absent when it is not. Only full-pipeline anonymization reveals the true pattern: homogeneous ensembles amplify identity-driven sycophancy when model identity is fully visible, while the heterogeneous production configuration shows the reverse. Model choice matters independently: one tested model exhibits baseline sycophancy two to three times higher than the others and near-zero deliberative conflict on ideological topics, making it structurally unsuitable for pipelines where genuine inter-role disagreement is the intended quality mechanism. Three practical conclusions follow. First, heterogeneous model ensembles are structurally more robust than homogeneous ones, achieving higher consensus rates and lower identity amplification. Second, full-pipeline anonymization is required for valid bias measurement -- partial anonymization is insufficient and actively misleading. Third, these findings have direct implications for the validation of multi-agent LLM systems in quality-critical applications: a system validated under partial anonymization or with a homogeneous ensemble may pass validation while retaining structural identity bias invisible to single-channel measurement.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统测量了TRUST民主话语分析管道中LLM组件的身份依赖性评分偏差。研究核心发现：单通道匿名化几乎不产生可检测偏差效应（各通道作用方向相反相互抵消），只有全管道匿名化才能揭示真实偏差模式。同质模型集成会放大身份驱动的谄媚效应，而异质集成则相反。研究为多智能体LLM系统的验证提供了重要实践指导。
AI.motivation: TRUST民主话语分析管道通过多个结构通道向LLM组件暴露对等模型身份，这一设计特性的偏差影响尚未得到实证检验，亟需系统测量。
AI.method: 跨越四个模型家族、两种匿名化范围，针对30条政治声明，对TRUST中所有活跃身份暴露通道进行身份依赖性评分偏差的系统测量。
AI.result: 单通道匿名化产生接近零的偏差效应，因各通道作用方向相反而相互抵消。仅全管道匿名化才能揭示真实模式：同质集成在模型身份完全可见时放大身份驱动谄媚，而异质生产配置则呈现相反效果。某模型基准谄媚度高出其他模型2-3倍，且在意识形态话题上几乎没有 deliberative conflict。
AI.conclusion: 三项实践结论：1）异质模型集成比同质集成更具结构鲁棒性，达成更高共识率并降低身份放大效应；2）全管道匿名化是有效偏差测量的必要条件，部分匿名化不足且具有误导性；3）在部分匿名化或同质集成条件下验证通过的系统可能保留结构性身份偏差，多智能体LLM系统的验证需要考虑这些因素。

title: Early Academic Capital as the Causal Origin of Dropout in Constrained Educational Systems -- Evidence from Longitudinal Data and Structural Causal Models
summary: Dropout in higher education is commonly analysed through observable academic events such as course failure or repetition. However, these event-based perspectives may obscure the underlying structural dynamics that shape student trajectories. In this study, we adopt a causal computational social science approach to identify the origins of dropout in a constrained engineering curriculum. Using longitudinal administrative data from 16,868 students who survived to their second active term, and a leakage-free panel design, we estimate the causal effect of early academic capital accumulation on three-year dropout. Treatment is defined as low early progress (passing at most 1 subject by the end of the second term). We employ G-estimation of structural nested mean models, complemented by marginal structural models with inverse probability weighting. We find a large and robust causal effect: low early academic capital increases dropout probability by 25.3 percentage points (G-estimation), closely matched by a 27.4 pp estimate from IPTW models. This effect is approximately twice as large as the estimated direct impact of later academic events such as first-time gateway-course repetition (12.7 pp). These findings suggest that dropout does not originate in isolated academic failures, but in early trajectory misalignment between academic progress and system-imposed temporal constraints. This perspective shifts the focus of intervention from downstream events to early-stage trajectory formation.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用因果计算社会科学方法，分析了16,868名工程专业学生的纵向数据，发现早期学业资本积累对三年后辍学有显著因果效应：早期进步不足使辍学概率增加约25-27个百分点，约为后期学业事件（如网关课程重修）直接影响的两倍。研究表明辍学并非源于孤立的学业失败，而是源于学业进步与系统时间约束之间的早期轨迹错位。
AI.motivation: 传统辍学研究多依赖可观察的学业事件（如课程不及格或留级），但这种事件视角可能掩盖塑造学生轨迹的潜在结构动力学。现有方法难以区分因果效应与混淆因素，亟需因果推断方法来识别辍学的真正起源。
AI.method: 采用泄漏防护的面板设计，利用G-estimation估计结构嵌套均值模型，并辅以逆概率加权（IPTW）的边际结构模型进行验证。处理变量定义为早期进步不足（第二学期末至多通过1门课程）。
AI.result: 研究发现早期学业资本积累对三年辍学有显著因果效应：G-estimation估计低早期进步使辍学概率增加25.3个百分点，IPTW模型估计为27.4个百分点，二者高度吻合。该效应约为后期网关课程首次重修直接影响（12.7个百分点）的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 辍学并非源于孤立的学业失败，而是源于学业进步与系统强加的时间约束之间的早期轨迹错位。这一发现将干预重点从下游事件转向早期轨迹形成阶段，具有重要的政策含义。

title: CoFi-PGMA: Counterfactual Policy Gradients under Filtered Feedback for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM) deployments increasingly rely on multi-agent architectures in which multiple models either compete through routing mechanisms or collaborate to produce a final answer. In both settings, the learning signal received by each agent is filtered by the system mechanism. Routing produces selection-gated feedback where only the chosen response is evaluated, while collaboration produces shared rewards that obscure the individual contribution of each agent. As a result, standard RLHF objectives designed for a single deployed policy become misspecified. We introduce CoFi-PGMA (Counterfactual Policy Gradients under Filtered Feedback for Multi-Agent LLMs), a unified framework for learning under filtered feedback in multi-agent LLM systems. Our approach derives a counterfactual per-agent training objective based on marginal contribution, which corrects the learning signal under both routing and collaborative mechanisms. For routing systems, the objective corresponds to off-policy corrections for selection-gated feedback, while for collaborative systems it reduces to leave-one-out difference rewards for credit assignment. We further analyze how softmax routing induces risk-sensitive incentives and provide practical training algorithms that integrate counterfactual estimators, multiturn-aware rewards, and policy optimization methods, and demonstrate the approach on a real-world reasoning dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CoFi-PGMA框架，解决多智能体LLM系统中学习信号被系统机制过滤导致的RLHF目标错误指定问题。该框架基于边际贡献的反事实策略梯度方法，对路由系统和协作系统分别采用离策略校正和留一法差分奖励进行信号纠正，并分析了softmax路由的风险敏感特性。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体LLM系统中的学习信号被系统机制过滤，导致标准RLHF目标失效。具体表现为：路由机制仅对被选中的响应提供评估反馈（选择门控反馈），而协作机制中个体贡献被共享奖励掩盖，使得原本针对单一部署策略设计的RLHF目标出现错误指定（misspecified）。
AI.method: 该方法通过边际贡献（marginal contribution）定义反事实训练目标。在路由系统中，通过离策略校正（off-policy corrections）处理选择门控反馈的偏差；在协作系统中，则简化为留一法差分奖励（leave-one-out difference rewards）进行贡献分配。同时分析了softmax路由如何诱导风险敏感激励，并设计了整合反事实估计器、多轮感知奖励与策略优化的训练算法。
AI.result: 在真实推理数据集上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，证明了通过反事实边际贡献校正可恢复有效的学习信号，从而改善多智能体LLM系统的决策质量。
AI.conclusion: CoFi-PGMA为多智能体LLM系统中的策略优化提供了理论基础与实践方案，通过反事实估计纠正过滤反馈中的偏差，为未来多智能体LLM系统的训练提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Multi-Turn Language Models
summary: Language models are increasingly deployed in interactive settings where users reason about facts over time rather than in isolation. In such scenarios, correct behavior requires models to maintain and update implicit temporal assumptions established earlier in a conversation. We study this challenge through the lens of temporal scope stability: the ability to preserve, override, or transfer time-scoped factual context across dialogue turns. We introduce ChronoScope, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark designed to isolate temporal scope behavior in controlled multi-turn interactions, comprising over one million deterministically generated question chains grounded in Wikidata. ChronoScope evaluates whether models can correctly retain inferred temporal scope when follow-up questions omit explicit time references, spanning implicit carryover, explicit scope switching, cross-entity transfer, and longer temporal trajectories. Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art language models, we find that temporal scope stability is frequently violated in controlled multi-turn settings, with models often drifting toward present-day assumptions despite correct underlying knowledge. These failures intensify with interaction length and persist even under oracle context conditions, revealing a gap between single-turn factual accuracy and coherent temporal reasoning under sequential interaction. We make our dataset and evaluation suite publicly available at https://github.com/yashkumaratri/ChronoScope

AI.tldr: 论文提出ChronoScope基准，用于评估语言模型在多轮对话中维持时间推理一致性的能力。通过对最先进模型的广泛评估，发现模型在单轮事实问答中表现准确，但在连续交互中无法保持时间范围稳定，揭示了单轮事实准确性与连贯时间推理之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 在实际交互场景中，用户通常在多轮对话中围绕事实进行推理，而非孤立问答。这要求语言模型能够维护和更新对话早期建立的隐式时间假设，而现有评估方法无法有效捕捉这一能力。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了ChronoScope大型诊断基准，包含超过100万个基于Wikidata确定生成的问答链，通过受控的多轮交互设置隔离时间范围行为，评估隐式继承、显式范围切换、跨实体转移和长时时间轨迹等场景。
AI.result: 前沿语言模型在受控多轮设置中频繁出现时间范围稳定性违规，往往偏离正确的时间假设而转向当下日期假设。这种失败随交互长度增加而加剧，即使在提供完美上下文条件下仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: ChronoScope基准和评估套件已公开开源，为评估语言模型在对话交互中的时间推理能力提供了标准化工具。

title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become central to modern AI workflows, powering applications from open-ended text generation to complex agent-based reasoning. However, debugging these models remains a persistent challenge due to their opaque and probabilistic nature and the difficulty of diagnosing errors across diverse tasks and settings. This paper introduces a systematic approach for LLM debugging that treats models as observable systems, providing structured, model-agnostic methods from issue detection to model refinement. By unifying evaluation, interpretability, and error-analysis practices, our approach enables practitioners to iteratively diagnose model weaknesses, refine prompts and model parameters, and adapt data for fine-tuning or assessment, while remaining effective in contexts where standardized benchmarks and evaluation criteria are lacking. We argue that such a structured methodology not only accelerates troubleshooting but also fosters reproducibility, transparency, and scalability in the deployment of LLM-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统的LLM调试方法，将模型视为可观测系统，通过统一评估、可解释性和错误分析，为问题检测到模型优化提供结构化、模型无关的方案，旨在提升LLM部署的可复现性、透明性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: LLM的调试面临持久挑战，原因在于其不透明性和概率特性，以及在多样化任务和场景中诊断错误的困难，尤其是在缺乏标准化基准和评估标准的情况下。
AI.method: 将LLM视为可观测系统，采用统一评估、可解释性和错误分析的方法，提供从问题检测到模型优化的模型无关（model-agnostic）结构化方法。
AI.result: practitioners能够迭代诊断模型弱点、优化提示词和模型参数、调整数据用于微调或评估。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为LLM部署中的调试提供了一种结构化、可复现、透明且可扩展的框架，有助于加速故障排除并推动基于LLM系统的实际应用。

title: KubePACS: Kubernetes Cluster Using Performant, Highly Available, and Cost Efficient Spot Instances
summary:
Cloud users aim to minimize cost while maximizing performance by selecting the most suitable instance types for their workloads. To reduce expenses, spot instances have been widely adopted due to their steep discounts compared to on-demand pricing. However, their use introduces reliability risks due to potential interruptions, and existing research has primarily focused on mitigating this trade-off from a cost or availability perspective alone. Despite the diversity in hardware capabilities among instance types, current provisioning systems tend to ignore performance variation, selecting nodes solely based on minimum resource requirements.
  In this paper, we present KubePACS, a Kubernetes-native spot instance provisioning system that constructs node pools optimized for both cost and performance while guaranteeing high availability. KubePACS formulates the node selection process as a multi-objective optimization problem, incorporating real-time data such as spot prices, performance benchmarks, and availability scores, including the multi-node Spot Placement Score (SPS). It solves this problem efficiently using an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) approach guided by the Golden Section Search (GSS) algorithm to find the optimal configuration. By integrating with the Karpenter node autoscaler, KubePACS jointly optimizes instance-type selection and node scaling decisions within a standard provisioning workflow. KubePACS also adopts a novel heuristic to support workload-specific preferences by scaling performance metrics for specialized instances. Through extensive evaluation across synthetic and real-world workloads, KubePACS demonstrates on average 55.09% and up to 81.06% higher performance per dollar over state-of-the-art solutions such as Karpenter, SpotVerse, and SpotKube, which only reference the spot instance prices and limited availability data.

AI.tldr: KubePACS是一个Kubernetes原生的spot实例配置系统，通过多目标优化方法综合考虑成本、性能和可用性，采用ILP+GSS算法求解，与Karpenter集成，在保证高可用性的同时实现了显著的成本效益提升。
AI.motivation: 云用户在使用spot实例时面临成本与可靠性的权衡，现有研究仅从成本或可用性角度解决问题，忽视了不同实例类型间的性能差异。当前配置系统仅基于最小资源需求选择节点，导致性能优化不足。
AI.method: 提出KubePACS系统，将节点选择问题建模为多目标优化问题，整合spot价格、性能基准测试、可用性评分（包括多节点Spot Placement Score）等实时数据。采用整数线性规划（ILP）结合黄金分割搜索（GSS）算法求解，并与Karpenter节点自动扩缩容器集成，通过启发式方法支持工作负载特定偏好。
AI.result: 在合成和真实工作负载上的评估表明，KubePACS相比Karpenter、SpotVerse和SpotKube等前沿方案，实现了平均55.09%、最高81.06%的每美元性能提升。
AI.conclusion: KubePACS成功地在保证高可用性的前提下，实现了成本与性能的综合优化，证明了在spot实例配置中引入性能指标的必要性。

title: Behavioral Intelligence Platforms: From Event Streams to Autonomous Insight via Probabilistic Journey Graphs, Behavioral Knowledge Extraction, and Grounded Language Generation
summary:
Contemporary product analytics systems require users to pose explicit queries, such as writing SQL, configuring dashboards, or constructing funnels, before insights can surface. This pull-based paradigm creates a bottleneck: it requires both domain knowledge and technical fluency, and assumes practitioners know in advance which questions to ask. We argue that behavioral analytics should move from passive systems that answer queries to active systems that continuously detect and explain behavioral phenomena.
  We present the Behavioral Intelligence Platform (BIP), a system architecture that transforms raw event streams into automatically generated insights. BIP consists of four layers. First, Normalization and State Derivation (NSD) standardizes events and maps them to a semantic state hierarchy. Second, a Behavioral Graph Engine (BGE) models user journeys as absorbing Markov chains and computes transition probabilities, removal effects, and path quality metrics. Third, a Behavioral Knowledge Graph (BKG) and Detector System convert graph outputs into grounded behavioral facts and identify behavioral phenomena. Finally, a Grounded Language Layer constrains large language model outputs to verified facts, producing reliable narrative insights.
  We formalize the Behavioral Intelligence Problem, introduce a taxonomy of detectors for autonomous insight generation, and propose an interestingness score to prioritize insights under limited attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为智能平台(BIP)，通过NSD标准化事件、BGE建模用户旅程为吸收马尔可夫链、BKG检测行为现象、Grounded Language Layer约束LLM输出，实现从被动查询到主动检测的行为分析范式转变，并提出检测器分类法和兴趣度评分机制。
AI.motivation: 传统产品分析系统依赖用户主动发起查询（SQL、仪表板配置、漏斗构建），形成知识瓶颈：既需要领域知识又需要技术能力，且假设用户预先知道要问什么问题。这种pull-based范式限制了行为洞察的发现效率。
AI.method: 提出四层系统架构：(1)NSD层标准化事件并映射到语义状态层次；(2)BGE层将用户旅程建模为吸收马尔可夫链，计算转移概率、剔除效应和路径质量指标；(3)BKG层结合检测器系统将图输出转换为可验证的行为事实；(4)语言层利用大语言模型生成叙事性洞察，输出被约束在已验证事实范围内。此外，还提出行为智能问题的形式化定义、检测器分类法和有限注意力下的兴趣度评分机制。
AI.result: 实现了从被动查询系统到主动检测系统的范式转变，构建了能够自动从原始事件流生成洞察的完整技术框架，为有限注意力下的优先级排序提供了可量化的兴趣度评分方案。
AI.conclusion: 提出BIP系统原型，证明了从pull-based查询范式向active检测范式转变的可行性，为行为分析系统的自动化和智能化提供了新的技术路径。

title: AI-Assisted Code Review as a Scaffold for Code Quality and Self-Regulated Learning: An Experience Report
summary: Code review is central to software engineering education but hard to scale in capstone projects due to tight deadlines, uneven peer feedback, and limited prior experience. We investigate an LLM-as-reviewer integrated directly into GitHub pull requests (human-in-the-loop) across two cohorts (more than 100 students, 2023--2024). Using a mixed-methods design -- GitHub data, reflective reports, and a targeted survey -- we examine engagement and responsiveness as behavioral indicators of self-regulated learning processes. Quantitatively, the 2024 cohort produced more iterative activity (1176 vs. 581 PRs), while technical issues observed in 2023 (227 failed AI attempts) dropped to zero after tool and instructional refinements. Despite different adoption levels (93\% vs. 50\% of teams using the tool), responsiveness was stable: 32\% (2023) and 33\% (2024) of successfully AI-reviewed PRs were followed by subsequent commits on the same PR. Qualitatively, students used the LLM's structured comments to focus reviews and discuss code quality, while guidance reduced over-reliance. We contribute: (i) an in-workflow design for an AI reviewer that scaffolds learning while mitigating cognitive offloading; (ii) a repeated cross sectional comparison across two cohorts in authentic settings; (iii) a mixed-methods analysis combining objective GitHub metrics with student self-reports; and (iv) evidence-based pedagogical recommendations for responsible, student-led AI-assisted review.

AI.tldr: 研究将LLM作为代码审查工具集成到GitHub pull requests中,跨越两个队列(100+名学生,2023-2024)进行实验。采用混合方法设计评估学生自调节学习的参与度和响应性指标。结果显示2024年PR迭代活动增加(1176 vs 581),技术问题从227次失败降至零,响应率保持稳定(32%→33%),定性分析表明学生利用LLM反馈聚焦代码审查讨论,同时指导减少了认知卸载依赖。
AI.motivation: 代码审查是软件工程教育的核心环节,但在毕业设计项目中难以规模化应用,主要面临截止日期紧张、同伴反馈质量参差不齐以及学生经验不足等挑战。
AI.method: 采用混合方法设计:两队列纵向研究(2023-2024),在GitHub pull requests中集成LLM审查工具(人机协作模式),收集GitHub数据、反思报告和有针对性的调查问卷,以参与度和响应性作为自调节学习的Behavioral indicators。
AI.result: 2024队列PR迭代活动显著增加(1176 vs 581);技术问题从227次AI失败降至零(工具和教学改进后);工具采用率差异明显(93% vs 50%),但响应率稳定(32%→33%);定性分析显示学生利用LLM结构化评论聚焦审查和讨论代码质量,指导有效减少了过度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献:(i)支持学习同时减轻认知卸载的工作流内AI审查设计;(ii)真实场景下的两队列重复横截面对比;(iii)结合GitHub客观指标与学生自报告的混合方法;(iv)负责任的学生主导AI辅助审查的循证教学建议。

title: Characterizations of Admissible Objective Functions for Hierarchical Clustering
summary: Hierarchical clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, yet for a long time it lacked a principled objective function. Dasgupta [STOC 2016] initiated a formal framework by introducing a discrete objective function for cluster trees. This framework was subsequently expanded by Cohen-Addad et al. [J. ACM 2019], who introduced the notion of admissibility -- a criterion ensuring that, whenever the input similarities admit consistent hierarchical representations, the minimizers of an objective function recover them. They also provided a necessary and sufficient condition for admissibility within a broad class of objective functions, which we refer to as sum-type objective functions. Our contributions are twofold. First, we characterize admissible sum-type objective functions when the scaling function g is a symmetric polynomial of degree at most two, together with sufficient conditions in the degree-three case. For admissible objective functions in this class, we show that the recursive sparsest cut algorithm achieves an O($φ$)-approximation ratio, where $φ$ denotes the approximation factor of the sparsest cut subroutine. Second, we introduce a new class of objective functions for hierarchical clustering, which we term max-type objective functions, where cluster interactions are measured by maximum rather than aggregate similarity. For this class, we establish a general characterization of admissibility for arbitrary scaling functions g, and a complete characterization when g is a symmetric polynomial of degree at most two. These results provide new theoretical insights into admissible objective functions for hierarchical clustering and clarify the scope of algorithmic guarantees for optimizing them.

AI.tldr: 本文对层次聚类的 admissible 目标函数进行了系统性表征：对于 sum-type 目标函数，完全刻画了二次多项式 scaling 函数的情况并给出了三次多项式的充分条件；对于新引入的 max-type 目标函数（基于最大相似性度量），建立了通用的 admissibility 理论，并同样在二次情形给出了完整表征。
AI.motivation: 层次聚类长期以来缺乏原则性的目标函数。Dasgupta (STOC 2016) 提出了离散目标函数的正式框架，Cohen-Addad 等人 (J. ACM 2019) 引入了 admissibility 概念以确保目标函数的最小化器能够恢复一致的层次表示。需要进一步刻画哪些目标函数是 admissible 的。
AI.method: 1. 对 degree ≤ 2 的对称多项式 scaling 函数 g 的 admissible sum-type 目标函数进行完整刻画，并给出 degree-3 情况下的充分条件；证明 recursive sparsest cut 算法对 admissible 目标函数可达到 O(φ)-近似比。2. 引入 max-type 目标函数类（使用最大相似性而非聚合相似性），对任意 scaling 函数 g 建立 admissibility 的一般刻画，并在 g 为二次多项式时给出完整表征。
AI.result: 1. 刻画了二次以内对称多项式 scaling 函数的 admissible sum-type 目标函数，并证明了递归最稀疏割算法的近似保证。2. 引入了 max-type 目标函数新类别，建立了其 admissibility 的完整理论框架。
AI.conclusion: 为层次聚类的 admissible 目标函数提供了新的理论洞察，阐明了优化它们的算法保证范围。这些表征结果明确了 sum-type 和 max-type 目标函数在何种条件下能够保证恢复一致的层次表示。

title: When VLMs 'Fix' Students: Identifying and Penalizing Over-Correction in the Evaluation of Multi-line Handwritten Math OCR
summary: Accurate transcription of handwritten mathematics is crucial for educational AI systems, yet current benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability properly. Most prior studies focus on single-line expressions and rely on lexical metrics such as BLEU, which fail to assess the semantic reasoning across multi-line student solutions. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of multi-line handwritten math Optical Character Recognition (OCR), revealing a critical failure mode of Vision-Language Models (VLMs): over-correction. Instead of faithfully transcribing a student's work, these models often "fix" errors, thereby hiding the very mistakes an educational assessment aims to detect. To address this, we propose PINK (Penalized INK-based score), a semantic evaluation metric that leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) for rubric-based grading and explicitly penalizes over-correction. Our comprehensive evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art VLMs on the FERMAT dataset reveals substantial ranking reversals compared to BLEU: models like GPT-4o are heavily penalized for aggressive over-correction, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash emerges as the most faithful transcriber. Furthermore, human expert studies show that PINK aligns significantly better with human judgment (55.0% preference over BLEU's 39.5%), providing a more reliable evaluation framework for handwritten math OCR in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首个系统研究多行手写数学OCR，发现VLMs存在"过度纠正"这一关键失败模式——模型擅自"修正"学生错误，掩盖了教育评估应检测的问题。为此提出PINK指标，通过LLM rubric评分并惩罚过度纠正，在FERMAT数据集上对15个SOTA VLM评估发现相比BLEU存在显著排名逆转，人类专家验证表明PINK更符合人类判断（55.0% vs 39.5%）。
AI.motivation: 当前基准测试无法正确评估手写数学转录能力——现有研究多聚焦于单行表达式，且依赖BLEU等词汇指标，无法评估多行学生解答中的语义推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出PINK（Penalized INK-based score）指标，利用LLM进行基于评分标准的评分，并明确惩罚过度纠正；2) 在FERMAT数据集上对15个SOTA VLM进行综合评估；3) 进行人类专家研究验证指标对齐度。
AI.result: 相比BLEU，PINK揭示了显著的排名逆转：GPT-4o因过度纠正被严重惩罚，而Gemini 2.5 Flash成为最忠实的转录模型。
AI.conclusion: PINK相比BLEU在评估手写数学OCR方面更可靠，显著更符合人类判断偏好（55.0% vs 39.5%），为教育场景中的手写数学OCR评估提供了更可靠的框架。

title: AutoCompress: Critical Layer Isolation for Efficient Transformer Compression
summary: We present AutoCompress, a transformer compression method motivated by an empirical finding: in small transformers, Layer 0 carries disproportionately high task-critical information, with an NTK-based importance score of 3.6 compared to a maximum of 0.054 for all other layers -- a gap of over 60x. Based on this finding, we propose Critical Layer Isolation (CLI), an architecture that protects Layer 0 at full dimensionality, compresses all intermediate layers through a learned bottleneck, and restores the full dimension at the final layer. Applied to GPT-2 Medium (354.8M parameters), CLI-GPT2 achieves 204.5 perplexity on WikiText-103 with only 143.8M parameters -- a 2.47x compression ratio and 59.5% parameter reduction. Crucially, an ablation study demonstrates that a uniform bottleneck baseline of comparable size achieves only 571.8 perplexity under identical training conditions, confirming that the architectural decision to protect Layer 0 -- rather than simply reducing model size -- is the primary driver of performance. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer的Layer 0承载了远超其他层的任务关键信息（NTK重要性得分差距超60倍），据此提出CLI架构保护首层完整维度、压缩中间层。在GPT-2 Medium上实现2.47倍压缩的同时保持204.5的困惑度，消融实验证实Layer 0保护是关键。
AI.motivation: 经验发现：在小型Transformer中，Layer 0携带了不成比例的高任务关键信息，其NTK重要性得分为3.6，而其他层最高仅为0.054，差距超过60倍。
AI.method: 提出Critical Layer Isolation (CLI)架构：保护Layer 0于完整维度，通过学习的bottleneck压缩所有中间层，并在最终层恢复完整维度。
AI.result: 应用于GPT-2 Medium (354.8M参数)，CLI-GPT2在WikiText-103上达到204.5困惑度，仅用143.8M参数，实现2.47倍压缩比和59.5%参数减少。对比实验证明统一bottleneck基线在相同训练条件下仅达571.8困惑度。
AI.conclusion: CLI通过保护Layer 0的架构决策（而非简单缩减模型规模）实现高效压缩，实验证实这一设计是性能提升的主要驱动力。

title: DeepImagine: Learning Biomedical Reasoning via Successive Counterfactual Imagining
summary: Predicting the outcomes of prospective clinical trials remains a major challenge for large language models. Prior work has shown that both traditional correlational predictors, such as random forests and logistic regression, and strong commercial LLMs achieve limited performance on this task. In this paper, we propose DeepImagine, a framework for teaching LLMs biomedical reasoning through successive counterfactual imagining. The central idea is to approximate hidden causal mechanisms of clinical trials by training models to infer how observed trial results would change under controlled perturbations of experimental conditions, such as dosage, outcome measures, study arms, geography, and other trial attributes. To support this objective, we construct both natural and approximate counterfactual pairs from real clinical trials with reported outcomes. For settings where strict counterfactual supervision is available, such as paired outcome measures or dose-ranging study arms within the same trial, we train models with supervised fine-tuning. For broader settings where only approximate counterfactual pairs can be retrieved, we optimize models with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards based on downstream benchmark correctness. We further augment training with synthetic reasoning traces that provide causally plausible explanations for local counterfactual transitions. Using this pipeline, we train language models under 10B parameters, including Qwen3.5-9B, and evaluate them on clinical trial outcome prediction. We aim to show that DeepImagine consistently improves over untuned language models and traditional correlational baselines. Finally, we aim to show that the learned reasoning trajectories provide interpretable signals about how models represent trial-level mechanisms, suggesting a practical path toward more mechanistic and scientifically useful biomedical language models.

AI.tldr: DeepImagine框架通过"反事实想象"训练大语言模型预测临床试验结果。核心思想是让模型学习临床试验在不同实验条件扰动下的结果变化机制，采用监督微调和强化学习两种训练方式，在10B参数规模模型上验证其在临床试验结果预测任务上的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型和传统机器学习方法（如随机森林、逻辑回归）在预测临床试验结果方面表现有限，需要更有效的生物医学推理能力。
AI.method: 通过"连续反事实想象"教授LLM生物医学推理：1）从真实临床试验构建自然和近似反事实配对；2）对有严格反事实监督的场景采用监督微调；3）对仅有近似反事实的场景采用强化学习（基于可验证奖励）；4）增强合成推理轨迹以提供因果解释。
AI.result: 目标表明DeepImagine在临床试验结果预测上持续优于未微调LLM和传统相关基线模型，学习到的推理轨迹提供了可解释的试验层面机制信号。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建更具机制性和科学实用性的生物医学语言模型提供了可行路径。

title: A Decoupled Human-in-the-Loop System for Controlled Autonomy in Agentic Workflows
summary:
AI agents are increasingly deployed to execute tasks and make decisions within agentic workflows, introducing new requirements for safe and controlled autonomy. Prior work has established the importance of human oversight for ensuring transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness in such systems. However, existing implementations of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanisms are typically embedded within application logic, limiting reuse, consistency, and scalability across multi-agent environments.
  This paper presents a decoupled HITL system architecture that treats human oversight as an independent system component within the agent operating environment. The proposed design separates human interaction management from application workflows through explicit interfaces and a structured execution model. In addition, a design framework is introduced to formalize HITL integration along four dimensions: intervention conditions, role resolution, interaction semantics, and communication channel. This framework enables selective and context-aware human involvement while maintaining system-level consistency.
  The approach supports alignment with emerging agent communication protocols, allowing HITL to be implemented as a protocol-level concern. By externalizing HITL and structuring its integration, the system provides a foundation for scalable governance and progressive autonomy in agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解耦的HITL系统架构，将人类监督作为智能体操作环境中的独立系统组件，并通过干预条件、角色解析、交互语义和通信通道四个维度的设计框架来形式化HITL集成，实现可扩展的治理和渐进式自主性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体在智能工作流中执行任务和做出决策，对安全可控自主性的需求日益增长。虽然先前工作已确立人类监督对透明度、问责制和可信度的重要性，但现有HITL实现通常嵌入应用逻辑中，缺乏跨多智能体环境的复用性、一致性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出解耦的HITL系统架构，通过显式接口和结构化执行模型将人类交互管理与应用工作流分离；引入四维度设计框架形式化HITL集成（干预条件、角色解析、交互语义、通信通道）；支持将HITL作为协议级问题实现，与新兴智能体通信协议对齐。
AI.result: 实现选择性、上下文感知的人类参与，同时维持系统级一致性；为智能工作流中的可扩展治理和渐进式自主性奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过将HITL外部化并结构化其集成，该系统为智能工作流中的可扩展治理和渐进式自主性提供了基础设施支持。

title: TACO: Efficient Communication Compression of Intermediate Tensors for Scalable Tensor-Parallel LLM Training
comment: Accepted by HPDC'26, 12 pages, 17 figures, 3 tables
summary: Handling communication overhead in large-scale tensor-parallel training remains a critical challenge due to the dense, near-zero distributions of intermediate tensors, which exacerbate errors under frequent communication and introduce significant computational overhead during compression. To this end, we propose TACO (Tensor-parallel Adaptive COmmunication compression), a robust FP8-based framework for compressing TP intermediate tensors. First, we employ a data-driven reshaping strategy combined with an Adaptive Scale-Hadamard Transform to enable high-fidelity FP8 quantization, while its Dual-Scale Quantization mechanism ensures numerical stability throughout training. Second, we design a highly fused compression operator to reduce memory traffic and kernel launch overhead, allowing efficient overlap with communication. Finally, we integrate TACO with existing state-of-the-art methods for Data and Pipeline Parallelism to develop a compression-enabled 3D-parallel training framework. Detailed experiments on GPT models and Qwen model demonstrate up to 1.87X end-to-end throughput improvement while maintaining near-lossless accuracy, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of TACO in large-scale training.

AI.tldr: TACO是一种针对大规模张量并行训练的高效FP8通信压缩框架，通过数据重塑、自适应Hadamard变换和双尺度量化等技术解决中间张量密集分布导致的量化误差问题，实现1.87倍端到端吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 大规模张量并行训练面临严峻的通信开销挑战，中间张量呈密集、近零分布，在频繁通信和压缩过程中容易引入显著误差和计算开销。
AI.method: 1) 数据驱动的重塑策略 + 自适应Scale-Hadamard变换实现高精度FP8量化；2) 双尺度量化机制保障训练数值稳定性；3) 高度融合的压缩算子减少内存访问和内核启动开销，实现与通信的高效Overlap；4) 与数据并行和流水线并行方法集成，构建压缩增强的3D并行训练框架。
AI.result: 在GPT和Qwen模型上的实验表明，TACO在保持近无损精度的前提下，实现最高1.87倍的端到端吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: TACO有效验证了FP8压缩技术在大型语言模型分布式训练中的有效性和高效性，为大规模训练系统的通信优化提供了新方案。

title: RCSB PDB AI Help Desk: retrieval-augmented generation for protein structure deposition support
summary:
Motivation: Structural Biologists have contributed more than 245,000 experimentally determined three-dimensional structures of biological macromolecules to the Protein Data Bank (PDB). Incoming data are validated and biocurated by ~20 expert biocurators across the wwPDB. RCSB PDB biocurators who process more than 40% of global depositions face increasing challenges in maintaining efficient Help Desk operations, with approximately 19,000 messages in approximately 8,000 entries received from depositors in 2025.
  Results: We developed an AI-powered Help Desk using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) built on LangChain with a pgvector store (PostgreSQL) and GPT-4.1-mini. The system employs pymupdf4llm for Markdown-preserving PDF extraction, two-stage document chunking, Maximal Marginal Relevance retrieval, a topical guardrail that filters off-topic queries, and a specialized system prompt that prevents exposure of internal terminology. A dual-LLM architecture uses separate model configurations for question condensing and response generation. Deployed in production on Kubernetes with PostgreSQL (pgvector), it provides around-the-clock depositor assistance with citation-backed, streaming responses.
  Availability and implementation: Freely available at https://rcsb-deposit-help.rcsb.org.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于RAG技术的AI Help Desk系统，帮助RCSB PDB biocurators处理大量的depositor咨询消息。该系统整合了GPT-4.1-mini、pgvector向量存储、MMR检索等技术，并包含topical guardrail和专用系统提示词等安全机制，已在Kubernetes上生产部署。
AI.motivation: RCSB PDB生物学家面临日益增长的Help Desk运营挑战：每年处理~19,000条来自~8,000个条目的消息，人工响应效率低下。
AI.method: 采用RAG架构：LangChain框架 + pgvector向量存储 + GPT-4.1-mini模型；pymupdf4llm实现Markdown保留的PDF提取；双阶段文档分块；MMR检索策略；topical guardrail过滤无关查询；专用系统提示词防止内部术语泄露；双LLM架构分别处理问题压缩和响应生成；Kubernetes + PostgreSQL生产环境部署。
AI.result: 实现7x24小时depositor辅助服务，提供带引用的流式响应，系统能有效过滤离题查询并保护内部术语。
AI.conclusion: 成功部署了基于RAG的AI Help Desk系统，为PDB depositors提供全天候自助服务，有效减轻了人工 biocurator 的工作负担。

title: Knowledge Lever Risk Management for Software Engineering: A Stochastic Framework for Mitigating Knowledge Loss
comment: A shorter version of the paper will be presented on the 24th IEEE/ACIS International Conference on Software Engineering Research, Management and Applications (SERA 2026)
summary:
Software engineering (SE) organizations operate in a knowledge-intensive domain where critical assets -- architectural expertise, design rationale, and system intuition -- are overwhelmingly tacit and volatile. The departure of key contributors or the decay of undocumented decisions can severely impair project velocity and software quality. While conventional SE risk management optimized for schedule and budget is common, the intangible knowledge risks that determine project success remain under-represented.
  The goal of this research work is to propose and evaluate the Knowledge Lever Risk Management (KLRM) Framework, designed specifically for the software development lifecycle. The primary objectives are to: (1) recast intangible knowledge assets as active mechanisms for risk mitigation (Knowledge Levers); (2) integrate these levers into a structured four-phase architecture (Audit, Alignment, Activation, Assurance); and (3) provide a formal stochastic model to quantify the impact of lever activation on project knowledge capital. We detail the application of these levers through software-specific practices such as pair programming, architectural decision records (ADRs), and LLM-assisted development. Stochastic Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that full lever activation increases expected knowledge capital by 63.8\% and virtually eliminates knowledge crisis probability. Our research shows that knowledge lever activation improves alignment across the project management iron triangle (scope, time, cost) by reducing rework and rediscovery costs.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出KLRM框架，将软件工程中的隐性知识资产转化为可量化的风险缓解杠杆。框架通过四阶段架构（审计、对齐、激活、保障）实现知识管理，模拟验证显示完全激活可提升63.8%知识资本并消除知识危机风险。
AI.motivation: 软件工程组织面临知识密集型挑战，关键知识资产（架构专业知识、设计理念、系统直觉）多为隐性且易失。核心人员流失或未归档决策的衰减会严重损害项目进度和质量。传统风险管理侧重于进度和预算，而决定项目成功与否的无形知识风险尚未得到充分关注。
AI.method: 该研究提出并评估了知识杠杆风险管理（KLRM）框架，涵盖四个阶段（审计、对齐、激活、保障）。框架将无形资产重新定义为可主动使用的知识杠杆，并通过随机蒙特卡洛模拟进行量化验证。具体实践包括结对编程、架构决策记录（ADR）和LLM辅助开发。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟表明，完全激活知识杠杆可使预期知识资本提升63.8%，并几乎消除知识危机概率。该方法通过降低返工和重复发现成本，改善了项目管理铁三角（范围、时间、成本）的对齐度。
AI.conclusion: KLRM框架通过结构化的知识杠杆激活机制，有效解决了软件工程中无形的知识风险问题，显著提升了项目知识资本并改善了项目管理铁三角的对齐度。

title: A Tight Lower Bound for Cycle Detection in Grid Graphs
summary: We prove that any algorithm for detecting cycles in an $m \times n$ grid graph, where cells are colored and adjacency is defined by matching colors, must read all $mn$ cells in the worst case for all grids with $m \geq 2$ and $n \geq 2$. The proof is by adversary argument: we construct an adaptive adversary that maintains ambiguity -- one completion containing a cycle and one without -- until the final cell is read. The construction proceeds by tiling the grid with $2 \times 2$, $2 \times 3$, $3 \times 2$, and $3 \times 3$ blocks, each equipped with an independent block adversary, composed via a checkerboard isolation scheme.

AI.tldr: 论文证明在检测具有颜色匹配邻接规则的m×n网格图中的环问题时，任何算法在最坏情况下必须读取全部mn个单元格。采用对手论证方法，通过棋盘隔离方案组合2×2、2×3、3×2、3×3独立模块对手来构造自适应对手。
AI.motivation: 研究在特定颜色匹配邻接规则下网格图环检测问题的算法复杂度下界。现有研究可能对一般图或简单网格的环检测有较好算法，而本研究旨在证明该特定问题无次线性算法。
AI.method: 对手论证(Adversary Argument)：(1) 构造自适应对手维持歧义状态；(2) 维持两个可能的图实例——一个有环，一个无环；(3) 对手根据算法查询动态调整策略；(4) 直到最后单元格被读取才能区分两种情况。通过棋盘隔离方案组合四种规格(2×2, 2×3, 3×2, 3×3)的独立模块对手实现。
AI.result: 对于所有m≥2, n≥2的网格，任何环检测算法在最坏情况下必须读取全部mn个单元格，即时间复杂度下界为Θ(mn)。
AI.conclusion: 该问题的信息论下界为全部输入大小，不存在次线性算法能可靠检测此类网格图中的环。棋盘隔离与模块化对手构造技术可推广至其他类似结构问题的下界证明。

title: GSAR: Typed Grounding for Hallucination Detection and Recovery in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary:
Autonomous multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly deployed to investigate operational incidents and produce structured diagnostic reports. Their trustworthiness hinges on whether each claim is grounded in observed evidence rather than model-internal inference. Existing groundedness evaluators (binary classifiers, LLM-as-judge scalars, self-correction loops) treat supporting evidence as interchangeable and emit a single signal that offers no principled control over downstream action.
  We present GSAR, a grounding-evaluation and replanning framework that (i) partitions claims into a four-way typology (grounded, ungrounded, contradicted, complementary), giving first-class standing to non-redundant alternative perspectives; (ii) assigns evidence-type-specific weights reflecting epistemic strength; (iii) computes an asymmetric contradiction-penalised weighted groundedness score; and (iv) couples that score to a three-tier decision function (proceed, regenerate, replan) driving a bounded-iteration outer loop under an explicit compute budget.
  We formalise the algorithm, prove six structural properties, and evaluate five design claims on FEVER with gold Wikipedia evidence under four independently-trained LLM judges (gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, gemini-2.5-pro). Every ablation reproduces in the same direction on every judge: bootstrap 95% CIs on the rho=0 effect exclude 0 on all four; the no-complementary ablation under Opus 4.7 has CI [-96,-68] of 200; at n=1000 three independent judges converge to DeltaS(rho=0)=+0.058. A head-to-head against Vectara HHEM-2.1-Open is included. To our knowledge, GSAR is the first published groundedness framework coupling evidence-typed scoring with tiered recovery under an explicit compute budget.

AI.tldr: GSAR是首个将证据类型化评分与分层恢复机制相结合、并在显式计算预算下运行的groundedness评估与 replanning 框架，通过四分类typology、非对称矛盾惩罚权重和三层决策函数，显著提升多智能体LLM系统的可信度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前自主多智能体LLM系统广泛应用于运营事件调查与结构化诊断报告生成，其可信度取决于claims是否基于可观测证据而非模型内部推理。现有groundedness评估方法（二元分类器、LLM-as-judge标量、自纠正循环）将支持证据视为可互换的，仅输出单一信号，无法对下游行动提供有原则的控制机制。
AI.method: 提出GSAR框架，包含四个核心设计：(1) 将claims划分为四类：grounded、ungrounded、contradicted、complementary，赋予非冗余替代视角独立地位；(2) 根据认知强度为不同证据类型分配类型特定权重；(3) 计算非对称的矛盾惩罚加权 groundedness 分数；(4) 将分数耦合到三层决策函数（proceed/regenerate/replan），在显式计算预算下驱动有界迭代外部循环。文中给出算法形式化描述并证明六条结构性质。
AI.result: 在FEVER数据集（使用Wikipedia黄金证据）上评估，采用四个独立训练的LLM评判模型（gpt-5.4、claude-sonnet-4-6、claude-opus-4-7、gemini-2.5-pro）进行验证。结果显示：(1) 所有消融实验在四个评判模型上均复现同向效果；(2) rho=0条件下bootstrap 95%置信区间均不包含0；(3) Opus 4.7上no-complementary消融的CI为[-96,-68]（满分为200）；(4) n=1000时三个独立评判模型收敛至DeltaS(rho=0)=+0.058；(5) 头对头比较优于Vectara HHEM-2.1-Open。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明GSAR在多个LLM评判模型上均显著优于现有基线方法（如Vectara HHEM-2.1-Open）。消融实验一致验证了complementary evidence类型的重要价值，所有削减实验在四个评判模型上均呈现同向效果。该框架首次将证据分类评分与分层恢复机制相结合，为可信赖的多智能体LLM系统提供了可量化的 groundedness 评估与可控的决策控制能力。

title: Epicure: Multidimensional Flavor Structure in Food Ingredient Embeddings
summary: A chef's intuition about flavor, texture, and cultural identity represents tacit knowledge that is difficult to articulate yet central to culinary practice. We show that this knowledge is already encoded in FlavorGraph's 300-dimensional ingredient embeddings, trained on recipe cooccurrence and food chemistry, and that it can be systematically recovered. An LLM-augmented curation pipeline consolidates 6,653 raw FlavorGraph ingredients into 1,032 canonical entries, substantially strengthening the recoverable structure. We identify at least fifteen independently classifiable dimensions spanning taste, texture, geography, food processing, and culture.

AI.tldr: 研究表明厨师关于风味、质地和文化认同的隐性烹饪知识已编码在 FlavorGraph 预训练的 300 维食材嵌入中，通过 LLM 增强的数据清洗和嵌入分析可系统性地恢复这些知识，共识别出 15 个跨 taste、texture、geography、food processing 和 culture 的独立维度。
AI.motivation: 厨师的隐性知识（包括对风味、质地和文化认同的直觉）难以明确表达，但对烹饪实践至关重要。传统方法无法有效捕捉和系统化这种 tacit knowledge。
AI.method: 使用 LLM 增强的策展管道，将 6,653 个原始 FlavorGraph 食材整合为 1,032 个规范条目，增强了可恢复结构。研究通过分析嵌入空间识别出至少 15 个独立可分类的维度。
AI.result: 成功从食材嵌入中恢复了涵盖味道、质地、地理、食品加工和文化等领域的至少 15 个独立可分类维度，证明厨师隐性 culinary knowledge 已编码于预训练嵌入中且可系统提取。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功证明了厨师的隐性 culinary knowledge (关于味道、质地和文化认同) 已经编码在 FlavorGraph 的 300 维食材嵌入中，且可以通过系统方法恢复。该研究为人工智能理解烹饪专业知识开辟了新路径。

title: Conformal PM2.5 Mapping Under Spatial Covariate Shift: Satellite-Reanalysis Fusion for Africa's Green Industrial Transition
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Index Terms: PM2.5 mapping, conformal prediction, covariate shift, spatial cross-validation, air quality, green industrialisation, trustworthy AI, Africa
summary: Africa's green industrialization imperative demands reliable infrastructure for monitoring air quality. We present a satellite-reanalysis PM2.5 fusion system trained on 2,068,901 records from 404 monitoring locations in 29 African countries (OpenAQ, 2017-2022), combining LightGBM with leakage-resistant spatial cross-validation and conformal prediction to quantify predictions and their geographic applicability limits. Under 5-fold location-grouped spatial cross-validation, LightGBM achieves RMSE = 30.83 +/- 5.07 ug/m3, MAE = 14.54 +/- 1.66 ug/m3, R2 = 0.134 +/- 0.023, and macro F1 = 0.336 +/- 0.018. This R2 is substantially below random-split benchmarks (>0.90) but reflects true geographic generalisation difficulty rather than model failure. Split conformal prediction targeting 90% marginal coverage reveals severe East Africa degradation (actual PICP = 65.3% vs. nominal 90%), consistent with medium-strength covariate shift (humidity KS = 0.2237, sat_pblh KS = 0.2558). We operationalise these findings through regional reliability flags (High/Medium/Low/Unreliable) and a monitor prioritisation score directing infrastructure expansion toward highest-burden unmonitored populations, directly supporting Africa's green industrial transition and SDGs 3.9, 7.1.2, 9, 11.6.2, and 13.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对非洲29个国家404个监测点的206万条记录，开发了基于LightGBM的卫星-再分析PM2.5融合预测系统。采用防泄漏的空间交叉验证和保角预测进行不确定性量化。模型R2=0.134，远低于随机划分基准（>0.90），但这反映的是真实地理泛化困难而非模型缺陷。保角预测发现东非地区覆盖率严重下降（65.3% vs 90%目标），存在湿度和行星边界层高度的协变量偏移。研究提出区域可靠性分级和监测点优先评分体系，为非洲绿色工业化转型和可持续发展目标提供支持。
AI.motivation: 非洲绿色工业化进程对空气质量监测基础设施提出了迫切需求。然而，非洲地区监测站点分布稀疏，数据可用性有限，难以准确评估PM2.5暴露及其健康影响。研究旨在构建一个能够跨地理区域泛化的PM2.5预测系统，并明确界定其适用边界，从而支持非洲大陆的环境治理与可持续发展。
AI.method: 研究采用LightGBM机器学习算法，融合卫星遥感数据与再分析数据构建PM2.5预测模型。训练数据集包含来自29个非洲国家404个监测站点共计2,068,901条记录（OpenAQ，2017-2022）。为防止数据泄漏，采用位置分组的5折空间交叉验证。引入保角预测（Conformal Prediction）方法进行不确定性量化，目标覆盖率为90%边际覆盖率。进一步通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验识别协变量偏移。
AI.result: 在5折位置分组空间交叉验证下，模型性能为：RMSE=30.83±5.07 μg/m³，MAE=14.54±1.66 μg/m³，R²=0.134±0.023，宏F1=0.336±0.018。随机划分基准R²超过0.90，表明空间泛化存在本质困难。保角预测显示东非地区实际覆盖率仅65.3%（目标90%），存在中等强度协变量偏移（湿度KS=0.2237，卫星行星边界层高度KS=0.2558）。研究开发了四级可靠性标志（高/中/低/不可靠）和监测优先评分以指导基础设施扩展。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功构建了首个覆盖非洲大陆的PM2.5卫星预测系统，并创新性地将保角预测与协变量偏移分析相结合，明确识别了模型的地理适用边界。东非地区因气象条件差异需谨慎使用或补充地面监测。研究提出的监测优先评分可有效指导有限资源向高负担未监测人群配置，直接服务于SDGs 3.9（减少环境死亡）、7.1.2（清洁能源）、9（工业创新）、11.6.2（城市空气质量）及13（气候行动）。该框架为数据稀缺地区的环境监测提供了可复制的方法论。

title: Implicit Framing in Obstetric Counseling Notes: A Grounded LLM Pipeline on a VBAC-Eligible Cohort
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at IEEE ICHI 2026. This is the author-accepted manuscript
summary: Clinical framing -- the linguistic manner in which clinical information is presented -- can influence patient understanding and decision-making, with important implications for healthcare outcomes. Obstetrics is a high-stakes domain in which physicians counsel patients on delivery mode choices such as vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) and repeat cesarean section (RCS), yet counseling language remains underexplored in large-scale clinical text analysis. In this work, we analyze physician counseling language in 2,024 obstetric history and physical narratives for a rigorously defined cohort of patients for whom both VBAC and RCS were clinically viable options. To control for confounding due to medical contraindications, we first construct a VBAC-eligible cohort using structured clinical data supplemented by a large language model (LLM)-based extraction pipeline constrained to grounded, verbatim evidence from free-text narratives. We then apply a zero-shot LLM framework to categorize counseling segments into predefined framing categories capturing how physicians linguistically present delivery options. Our analysis reveals a significant difference in counseling framing distributions between VBAC and RCS notes; risk-focused language accounts for a substantially larger share of counseling segments in RCS documentation than in VBAC, with category-level differences confirmed by statistical testing, highlighting the value of controlled LLM-based framing analysis in obstetric care.

title: Don't Make the LLM Read the Graph: Make the Graph Think
comment: main body has 9 pages, 4 figures, under review for COLM 2026 conference
summary: We investigate whether explicit belief graphs improve LLM performance in cooperative multi-agent reasoning. Through 3,000+ controlled trials across four LLM families in the cooperative card game Hanabi, we establish four findings. First, integration architecture determines whether belief graphs provide value: as prompt context, graphs are decorative for strong models and beneficial only for weak models on 2nd-order Theory of Mind (80% vs 10%, p<0.0001, OR=36.0); when graphs gate action selection through ranked shortlists, they become structurally essential even for strong models (100% vs 20% on 2nd-order ToM, p<0.001). Second, we identify "Planner Defiance," a model-family-specific failure where LLMs override correct planner recommendations at partial competence (90% override, replicated N=20); Gemini models show near-zero defiance while Llama 70B shows 90%, and models distinguish factual context (deferred to) from advisory recommendations (overridden). Third, full-game evidence confirms inter-agent conventions (+128% over baseline, p=0.003) outperform all single-agent interventions, and individual belief-graph components must be combined to produce gains. Fourth, preliminary scaling analysis (N=10/cell, exploratory) suggests graph depth has diminishing returns: shallow graphs provide the best cost-benefit ratio, while deeper ToM graphs appear harmful at larger player counts (-1.5 pts at 5-player, p=0.029).

AI.tldr: 研究探索显式信念图谱是否能提升LLM在合作多智能体推理中的表现。基于3000+次实验，使用Hanabi合作卡牌游戏作为测试平台，发现：1）集成架构决定信念图谱的价值；2）发现"规划者抗命"现象——LLM会覆盖正确的规划建议；3）智能体间约定优于所有单智能体干预；4）浅层信念图谱具有最佳成本效益比。
AI.motivation: LLM在多智能体协作任务中的表现受限，现有方法缺乏对智能体间信念建模的显式机制。研究旨在系统性地探索信念图谱在合作推理中的价值。
AI.method: 在Hanabi游戏中进行3000+次对照实验，涵盖4个LLM家族，通过操控信念图谱的集成方式（作为提示上下文或通过排名候选名单引导行动选择）来评估其效果。
AI.result: 1）信念图谱的价值取决于集成架构：作为上下文时仅对弱模型二阶心智理论有益（80% vs 10%）；作为行动选择门控时对所有模型均有效（100% vs 20%）。2）发现"规划者抗命"现象：模型族特异性失败，Llama 70B的90%会覆盖正确建议，Gemini近乎为零。3）智能体间约定超越所有单智能体干预（+128%）。4）深层ToM图谱在多玩家场景中可能有害。
AI.conclusion: 信念图谱的集成方式比图谱本身更重要；浅层信念建模具有最佳成本效益；智能体间约定的建立对合作任务至关重要。

title: Unfolding an Atomistic World: Atomistic Simulation of Reactor Pressure Vessel Steel Across Year-and-Meter Scales
summary: Lifetime prediction of reactor pressure vessel (RPV) steel requires bridging atomistic degradation mechanisms with service-scale spatial and temporal regimes, from Angstroms and picoseconds to meters and decades. Existing engineering-scale models provide long-range reach but rely on fitted degradation laws, while recent atomistic kinetic Monte Carlo (AKMC) advances still fail to achieve year-and-meter-scale coverage. We present AtomWorld, an atomistic world-modeling framework for RPV steel lifetime simulation co-designed with leadership-scale supercomputing through three tightly coupled layers: (1) algorithm: AtomWorld recasts classical AKMC as an atomistic world model that learns consequence-aware state transitions over the ab initio energy landscape; (2) HPC: it co-designs this formulation with modern supercomputers, yielding a compute-dense, synchronization-light, and communication-efficient execution pipeline; and (3) application: it extends atomistic world modeling to engineering-scale simulation through a physically grounded voxel-parallel framework, offering a scalable pathway from local atomistic dynamics to engineering-scale degradation evolution. We demonstrate a paradigm shift in atomistic simulation: AtomWorld enables atomistic simulation of RPV steel across year-and-meter scales for the first time, extending direct atomistic modeling to ten-quintillion-atom systems and achieving a time-to-solution of 1.71 days for one simulated service year. These capabilities are sustained across five leadership supercomputers with 92-97% scaling efficiency and peak performance up to 1.27 EFLOP/s, corresponding to 48% of the Lineshine peak FP64 performance.

AI.tldr: AtomWorld是一个面向反应堆压力容器钢寿命模拟的原子级世界建模框架，通过算法-高性能计算-应用三层协同设计，首次在年-米时空尺度上实现原子级模拟突破，可处理十quintillion原子系统，单年模拟耗时1.71天，在旗舰超算上达到1.27 EFLOP/s峰值性能，扩展效率92-97%。
AI.motivation: 反应堆压力容器(RPV)钢寿命预测需要跨越多个时空尺度（从埃和皮秒到米和数十年），现有工程尺度模型依赖经验拟合的退化定律，而最新的原子动力学KMC(AKMC)方法仍无法覆盖年-米尺度的模拟需求，存在严重的尺度鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出三层协同设计框架：(1) 算法层：将传统AKMC重新定义为原子级世界模型，学习基于第一性原理能量地貌的后果感知状态转移；(2) HPC层：与现代超算平台协同设计，实现计算密集型、同步轻量级、通信高效的执行流水线；(3) 应用层：通过物理驱动的体素并行框架，将原子级世界建模扩展至工程尺度模拟。
AI.result: 实现了RPV钢年-米尺度原子模拟的突破，可处理十quintillion（10^19）原子量级系统，单个服役年模拟时间为1.71天；在五台旗舰超算上保持92-97%的扩展效率，峰值性能达1.27 EFLOP/s（对应Linpack峰值的48%）。
AI.conclusion: AtomWorld代表原子模拟的范式转变，首次实现了反应堆压力容器钢在年-米尺度上的原子级模拟。该框架通过算法、高性能计算和应用三层协同设计，突破了传统原子模拟的时空尺度限制，为核电站关键部件的全寿命周期预测提供了全新的原子级模拟路径，对核材料科学与工程寿命管理具有重要意义。

title: Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Factual Queries
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been proposed to mitigate hallucinations in large language models (LLMs), where generated outputs may be factually incorrect. However, existing RAG approaches predominantly rely on vector similarity for retrieval, which is prone to semantic noise and fails to ensure that generated responses fully satisfy the complex conditions specified by factual queries, often leading to incorrect answers. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel research problem, named Exact Retrieval Problem (ERP). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first problem formulation that explicitly incorporates structural information into RAG for factual questions to satisfy all query conditions. For this novel problem, we propose Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SG-RAG), which models the retrieval process as an embedding-based subgraph matching task, and uses the retrieved topological structures to guide the LLM to generate answers that meet all specified query conditions. To facilitate evaluation of ERP, we construct and publicly release Exact Retrieval Question Answering (ERQA), a large-scale dataset comprising 120000 fact-oriented QA pairs, each involving complex conditions, spanning 20 diverse domains. The experimental results demonstrate that SG-RAG significantly outperforms strong baselines on ERQA, delivering absolute improvements from 20.68 to 50.88 points across all evaluation metrics, while maintaining reasonable computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了精确检索问题（ERP），旨在解决现有RAG方法因仅依赖向量相似性而导致的语义噪声和条件满足不完整问题。提出了SG-RAG方法，通过子图匹配任务融入结构信息引导LLM生成，并构建了包含12万个问答对的大规模评估数据集ERQA，覆盖20个领域。实验表明SG-RAG在所有指标上实现了20.68至50.88点的绝对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法主要依赖向量相似性进行检索，存在两个核心问题：(1) 语义噪声：检索结果在语义层面可能包含大量不相关信息；(2) 条件满足不完整：无法确保生成的响应完全满足事实性查询中的复杂条件约束，导致回答错误。作者认为需要引入结构化信息来增强检索的精确性。
AI.method: 作者提出两项核心贡献：(1) 问题形式化：定义"精确检索问题（ERP）"，首次明确将结构信息纳入RAG以满足事实性查询的所有条件；(2) 方法设计：提出SG-RAG，将检索过程建模为基于嵌入的子图匹配任务，利用检索到的拓扑结构引导LLM生成满足所有查询条件的答案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SG-RAG在ERQA数据集上显著优于强基线模型，在所有评估指标上实现了20.68至50.88个百分点的绝对提升，同时保持了合理的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过将结构化信息显式融入RAG检索过程，SG-RAG有效解决了传统方法的条件满足问题。ERQA数据集的构建为该领域提供了标准化的评估基准。实验验证了结构引导方法在提升RAG系统事实准确性方面的有效性。

title: Can LLMs be Effective Code Contributors? A Study on Open-source Projects
summary: LLM-generated code is widely used, and the share of committed code produced by LLMs is expected to increase. However, we are not at a point where LLMs can be effective contributors to production code. We present an approach that exposes the shortcomings of LLM generation on such projects, and proposes recommendations; the targets of our study are sizable open-source projects, e.g., FFmpeg and wolfSSL. First, we developed a framework that uses verification and validation to evaluate a given LLM's suitability to fix or add features to an existing project. Second, we apply the framework to 212 commits (bug fixes and small feature improvements) in eight popular open-source projects and three LLMs: GPT-4o, Ministral3, and Qwen3-Coder. The success rate varied from 0% to 60% depending on the project. The LLMs failed in a variety of ways, from generating syntactically incorrect code, to producing code that fails basic (static) verification, or validation via the project's test suite. In particular, the LLMs struggle with generating new code, handling contexts (function or file) outside a certain size range, and in many cases their success is due to parroting code changes they have been trained on.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了LLM（GPT-4o、Ministral3、Qwen3-Coder）在真实开源项目（FFmpeg、wolfSSL等）中生成生产代码的能力。通过212个提交任务的验证测试，成功率仅为0-60%，暴露了LLM在代码生成、上下文处理和泛化能力方面的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的代码在提交中的占比日益增加，但LLM是否能够有效参与生产代码仍不明确。本研究旨在系统性地评估LLM在大型开源项目中修复bug和添加功能的能力，并揭示其不足之处。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了一个基于验证与确认（V&V）框架，应用于8个流行开源项目中的212个提交任务（bug修复和小功能改进），对GPT-4o、Ministral3和Qwen3-Coder三个LLM进行评估。
AI.result: LLM的成功率因项目而异，从0%到60%不等。失败模式多样：生成语法错误的代码、通过不了静态验证、或无法通过项目测试套件验证。
AI.conclusion: LLM在生成新代码、处理超出特定范围的上下文（函数或文件大小）时存在困难，其"成功"在很大程度上可能依赖于对训练数据中已有代码变更的复述，而非真正的泛化能力。

title: Dynamic Grammar-Compressed Self-Index in $delta$-Optimal Space
summary: A compressed self-index stores a string in compressed form while supporting locate queries without decompression. For highly repetitive strings (arising in web crawls, versioned documents, and genomic collections), static self-indexes can match the $δ$-optimal lower bound of $Ω(δ\log(n \log σ/ (δ\log n)) \log n)$ bits up to constant factors, where $n$ is the string length, $σ$ is the alphabet size, and $δ$ is the substring complexity. Their dynamic counterparts, however, remain scarce: every existing dynamic self-index either fails to attain $δ$-optimal space, pays at least $Θ(\log n)$ time per reported occurrence during locate, or exposes the longest common prefix (LCP) of the text inside its update time. We present the dynamic RR-index, a dynamic grammar-compressed self-index built on the restricted recompression run-length straight-line program (RLSLP). To our knowledge, it is the first dynamic self-index to attain $δ$-optimal space. The index occupies expected $O(δ\log(n \log σ/ (δ\log n)) \log n)$ bits, answers locate queries in expected $O(m + \log m \log^{2} n + \mathit{occ} (\log n / \log \log n))$ time (where $m$ is the pattern length and $\mathit{occ}$ is the number of occurrences), and supports insertions and deletions of a length-$m'$ substring in expected amortized $O(m' \log^{2} n + \log^{3} n)$ time, with no dependence on the LCP. On eleven highly repetitive corpora, including a $37$ GB Wikipedia dump and a $59$ GB human-chromosome collection, the dynamic RR-index is up to $77\times$ faster than the dynamic r-index on updates and up to $11\times$ faster than other dynamic indexes on locate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态RR-index，首个达到δ-最优空间的动态语法压缩自索引。基于RLSLP构建，在高度重复字符串上实现最优空间的同时，支持高效定位查询（O(m + occ log n/log log n)）和动态更新（O(m' log² n + log³ n)），且不暴露LCP。在37GB维基百科和59GB人类染色体数据集上验证，性能显著优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有动态自索引存在三个主要瓶颈：无法达到δ-最优空间、定位查询需Θ(log n)时间报告每个出现位置、或在更新时暴露最长公共前缀（LCP）。对于网页爬取、版本化文档和基因组集合等高度重复的字符串，需要一种能同时满足空间最优和时间高效的动态索引结构。
AI.method: 该索引基于受限重压缩游程直线式程序（RLSLP）构建。通过维护RLSLP的压缩表示，结合高效的查询处理算法，实现在保持δ-最优空间的同时，支持快速的位置查询和动态更新操作。
AI.result: 该索引在11个高度重复的语料库上进行了实验评估。在更新操作上比动态r-index快最多77倍，在定位操作上比其他动态索引快最多11倍。索引占用预期O(δ log(n log σ/(δ log n)) log n)位空间，定位查询时间为O(m + log m log² n + occ (log n/log log n))，插入/删除时间为O(m' log² n + log³ n)摊销时间，且不依赖LCP。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了第一个达到δ-最优空间的动态自索引结构，解决了现有动态自索引在空间效率、时间复杂度或LCP依赖性方面的权衡困境。实验表明，该索引在真实大规模数据集上（37GB维基百科和59GB人类染色体集合）显著优于现有方法，更新操作最高快77倍，定位操作最高快11倍。

title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
comment: 25 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Submitted to Applied Intelligence (Springer)
summary:
Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems.
  A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims.
  This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文为人工智能中七种信息论和复杂性度量（熵、交叉熵、互信息、传递熵、整合信息Φ、有效信息EI、自主性）提供了实用的决策框架，通过流程图和决策表来指导从业者选择合适的度量方法。
AI.motivation: 信息论度量在人工智能中应用广泛（决策树、不确定性量化、表征学习、特征选择、动态系统分析），但度量的选择往往与估计器假设、失效模式和可靠推理条件相脱节，导致实践者难以正确应用这些工具。
AI.method: 围绕三个规范性问题组织框架：(i) 度量回答什么问题及适用的AI场景；(ii) 针对数据类型和维度选择何种估计器；(iii) 最危险的误用是什么。通过流程图和主决策表将框架操作化，并用表征学习、时间影响分析和演化智能体复杂性三个案例进行说明。
AI.result: 建立了包含度量选择流程图和主决策表的完整决策框架，覆盖AI/ML和决策智能体两大应用领域，并提供标准化的"桥接框"将信息论量与认知结构关联。
AI.conclusion: 该框架弥合了理论度量与实践应用之间的差距，为研究者和从业者提供了系统化的度量选择指南，有助于在具体应用场景中做出更可靠的推断和决策。

title: UGAF-ITS: A Standards Harmonization Framework and Validation Tool for Multi-Framework AI Governance in Distributed Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary:
Organizations deploying AI-enabled Intelligent Transportation Systems face fragmented governance: ISO/IEC 42001 demands a certifiable management system, the EU AI Act imposes binding high-risk obligations from August 2026, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework structures voluntary practice. Each instrument is internally coherent, yet they drive different control vocabularies, evidence expectations, and audit rhythms. In distributed ITS deployments where vehicle manufacturers, roadside integrators, and cloud operators each hold partial evidence and partial accountability, this fragmentation multiplies compliance effort and obscures incident traceability.
  This paper introduces UGAF-ITS, a standards harmonization framework that consolidates 154 source obligations from the three instruments into 12 unified controls across eight governance domains through a reproducible five-phase crosswalk methodology. A three-tier operating model allocates each control to the vehicle, edge, or cloud tier where enforcement and defensible evidence production are feasible. An evidence backbone of 20 versioned artifacts supports a single audit package across all three frameworks without duplicating content.
  We validate UGAF-ITS through an open-source governance engine evaluated across four architecturally distinct ITS deployment scenarios. The engine encodes the complete crosswalk catalog and executes eight compliance computations. Three-tier deployments achieve 91.7% average framework coverage with 45.9% evidence reduction, complete bidirectional traceability, and 80% of artifacts serving all three frameworks simultaneously. Partial deployments degrade gracefully: coverage and reduction scale with architectural complexity. The tool, scenarios, and all reported results are publicly available for independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI智能交通系统面临的多元标准治理碎片化问题，提出UGAF-ITS统一治理框架。该框架通过五阶段方法论将154项源义务整合为12项跨框架控制措施，构建三层运营模型和证据主干，实现单一审计包覆盖ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act和NIST AI RMF三大标准，验证实现91.7%覆盖率与45.9%证据减少。
AI.motivation: AI赋能智能交通系统（ITS）面临治理碎片化困境：ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act和NIST AI RMF三项标准各具内部一致性，但驱动不同控制词汇、证据期望和审计节奏。在车辆制造商、路侧集成商和云运营商各自持有部分证据和部分责任的分布式ITS部署中，这种碎片化倍增合规工作量并模糊事件溯源能力。
AI.method: 采用可复现的五阶段交叉映射方法论，将154项源义务整合为12项统一控制措施，分配至车辆层、边缘层和云层三层运营模型，并建立包含20个版本化工件证据主干的单一审计包。
AI.result: 三层部署实现91.7%平均框架覆盖率，证据减少45.9%，完全双向可溯源，80%工件同时服务三个框架。部分部署可优雅降级，覆盖率和减少率随架构复杂性缩放。

title: Avionic Main Fuel Pump Simulation and Fault-Diagnosis Benchmark
summary: In many cyber-physical systems, especially in critical applications such as aeroplanes, data to train anomaly detection and diagnosis algorithms is lacking due to data protection issues and partial observability. To combat this inherent lack of data, we introduce a high-fidelity, physics-informed co-simulation of a common aircraft main-fuel-pump system modelled in \textsc{MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Fluids}. We also describe its generated time-series data with health and fault mode annotations. To show feasibility of our benchmark, we apply an unsupervised Recurrent Variational Autoencoder (RNN-VAE) for anomaly detection and a SOM-VAE for operating mode discretization, trained to separate healthy and faulty conditions.

title: ContextWeaver: Selective and Dependency-Structured Memory Construction for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often struggle in long-context interactions. As the agent accumulates more interaction history, context management approaches such as sliding window and prompt compression may omit earlier structured information that later steps rely on. Recent retrieval-based memory systems surface relevant content but still overlook the causal and logical structure needed for multi-step reasoning. We introduce ContextWeaver, a selective and dependency-structured memory framework that organizes an agent's interaction trace into a graph of reasoning steps and selects the relevant context for future actions. Unlike prior context management approaches, ContextWeaver supports: (1) dependency-based construction and traversal that link each step to the earlier steps it relies on; (2) compact dependency summarization that condenses root-to-step reasoning paths into reusable units; and (3) a lightweight validation layer that incorporates execution feedback. On the SWE-Bench Verified and Lite benchmarks, ContextWeaver improves performance over a sliding-window baseline in pass@1, while reducing reasoning steps and token usage. Our observations suggest that modeling logical dependencies provides a stable and scalable memory mechanism for LLM agents that use tools.

AI.tldr: ContextWeaver通过构建依赖结构化的记忆图谱来解决LLM智能体在长上下文交互中的信息遗漏问题，在SWE-Bench基准上提升性能的同时降低推理步骤和token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长上下文交互中表现不佳。现有上下文管理方法（如滑动窗口、提示压缩）可能遗漏后续步骤依赖的早期结构化信息；基于检索的记忆系统虽能召回相关内容，但忽视了多步推理所需的因果和逻辑结构。
AI.method: ContextWeaver是一种选择性的依赖结构化记忆框架，将智能体的交互轨迹组织为推理步骤图，并选择相关上下文用于未来行动。具体包括：(1) 基于依赖的构建与遍历，链接每个步骤与其依赖的前序步骤；(2) 紧凑依赖摘要，将根节点到目标步骤的推理路径压缩为可复用单元；(3) 轻量级验证层，整合执行反馈。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Verified和Lite基准测试中，ContextWeaver相比滑动窗口基线在pass@1指标上提升性能，同时减少推理步骤和token使用量。
AI.conclusion: 建模逻辑依赖为使用工具的LLM智能体提供了一种稳定且可扩展的记忆机制。

title: Analytica: Soft Propositional Reasoning for Robust and Scalable LLM-Driven Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly tasked with complex real-world analysis (e.g., in financial forecasting, scientific discovery), yet their reasoning suffers from stochastic instability and lacks a verifiable, compositional structure. To address this, we introduce Analytica, a novel agent architecture built on the principle of Soft Propositional Reasoning (SPR). SPR reframes complex analysis as a structured process of estimating the soft truth values of different outcome propositions, allowing us to formally model and minimize the estimation error in terms of its bias and variance. Analytica operationalizes this through a parallel, divide-and-conquer framework that systematically reduces both sources of error. To reduce bias, problems are first decomposed into a tree of subpropositions, and tool-equipped LLM grounder agents are employed, including a novel Jupyter Notebook agent for data-driven analysis, that help to validate and score facts. To reduce variance, Analytica recursively synthesizes these grounded leaves using robust linear models that average out stochastic noise with superior efficiency, scalability, and enable interactive "what-if" scenario analysis. Our theoretical and empirical results on economic, financial, and political forecasting tasks show that Analytica improves 15.84% accuracy on average over diverse base models, achieving 71.06% accuracy with the lowest variance of 6.02% when working with a Deep Research grounder. Our Jupyter Notebook grounder shows strong cost-effectiveness that achieves a close 70.11% accuracy with 90.35% less cost and 52.85% less time. Analytica also exhibits highly noise-resilient and stable performance growth as the analysis depth increases, with a near-linear time complexity, as well as good adaptivity to open-weight LLMs and scientific domains.

AI.tldr: Analytica是一种基于软命题推理（SPR）原则构建的新型LLM智能体架构，通过并行分治框架系统性地减少推理过程中的偏差和方差，从而提升复杂分析任务（如经济、金融、政治预测）的准确性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在复杂现实分析任务（如金融预测、科学发现）中存在推理不稳定、缺乏可验证性和组合结构的问题。现有方法难以形式化建模和优化推理误差。
AI.method: SPR将复杂分析重新定义为估计不同结果命题的软真值的过程。Analytica通过两个核心机制降低误差：(1) 降低偏差：使用树形结构分解问题为子命题，配备工具的LLM接地智能体（包括新型Jupyter Notebook智能体）验证和评分事实；(2) 降低方差：使用稳健线性模型递归综合已接地叶子节点，以平均化随机噪声。
AI.result: 在经济、金融和政治预测任务中，Analytica相比多种基线模型平均提升15.84%准确率。使用深度研究接地器达到71.06%准确率（最低方差6.02%）；Jupyter Notebook接地器以90.35%更低成本和52.85%更少时间达到70.11%准确率，展现强成本效益。
AI.conclusion: Analytica展现出高噪声韧性和稳定的性能增长，随分析深度增加呈近线性时间复杂度，并对开源LLM和科学领域具有良好的适应性。

title: Exact, Efficient, and Reliable Multi-Objective and Multi-Constrained IoT Workflow Scheduling in Edge-Hub-Cloud Cyber-Physical Systems
comment: This version of the manuscript has been accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Journal after peer review (Author Accepted Manuscript). It is not the final published version (Version of Record) and does not reflect any post-acceptance improvements. The Version of Record is available online at https://doi.org/10.1109/JIOT.2026.3665298
summary: Emerging IoT-enabled cyber-physical applications demand low-latency, energy-efficient, and reliable execution across resource-constrained edge devices with heterogeneous multicore processors and diverse sensing and actuating capabilities, in collaboration with a hub device and a cloud server. These workflow-based applications comprise interdependent tasks that must be executed under stringent deadline, reliability, capability, memory, storage, and energy constraints. Given their critical nature, exact optimization is necessary to obtain optimal schedules that ensure dependable operation. Existing scheduling approaches, both exact and heuristic, fail to jointly address all these objectives and constraints. To this end, we propose an exact multi-objective and multi-constrained workflow scheduling approach for edge-hub-cloud cyber-physical systems, based on continuous-time mixed integer linear programming. The proposed formulation jointly optimizes latency, energy, and reliability, while holistically addressing timing and resource constraints. To enhance reliability while avoiding the overhead of unnecessary task replicas, it selectively employs task duplication. We evaluate our approach against a widely used heuristic, which we extend to ensure a fair and meaningful comparison, using a real-world IoT workflow and synthetic task graphs of varying sizes, across different system configurations and objective trade-offs. The proposed method consistently outperforms the heuristic, achieving up to 29.83%, 33.96%, and 28.49% average improvements in latency, energy, and reliability, respectively, while attaining practical runtimes. Overall, the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach under various system configurations and objective trade-offs, and show its practical scalability to task graphs of sizes relevant to the targeted applications and system architecture.
